credits.overview: The experiences of a young sex worker as she navigates the streets at night.

credits.title: The Dogs
credits.overview: A battered wife and her young son seek refuge on a remote housing estate; they just need to cross a dark, open field. Adapted from a short story by Hanif Kureshi, The Dogs explores the paranoia and urban legends that inform modern life.
